headword: {中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}
reading: ちゅうおうぶんりたい

definitions.gloss: median strip; central reservation (of a road)
definitions.explanation: The strip in the middle of a road that separates traffic moving in opposite directions. May be a raised curb, a planted area, or a barrier.

examples.japanese: {中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植|う}えてある→植える：01210_ueru⟧。
examples.english: Trees are planted in the median strip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The car rode up onto the median strip.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{反対車線|はんたいしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This road has a median strip, so there is no worry of crossing into the oncoming lane.

notes:
A road-engineering term. Separates opposing traffic to prevent head-on collisions. Often shortened to {分離帯|ぶんりたい} in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる: to ride up onto the median
- {中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガードレール→ガードレール：06517_gaadoreeru⟧: the guardrail on the median
- {植|う}え{込|こ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央分離帯|ちゅうおうぶんりたい}: a planted median strip
